regions.finding: Two Et2Zn control branches and the failed EtMgBr heated branch were extracted as separate experiments; the complicated mixture remains compositionally unresolved.

The two organolithium additions and two subsequent LDA ring openings were separated into four successive-stage experiment records.
Three scope rows plus the distinct 69% THF conversion comparison were extracted. The printed entry-3 organolithium inconsistency is preserved without correction.
Five LDA-promoted ring-opening rows were extracted with times, temperature override, isolated yields, and reported stereoselectivity.
